title: Beta Distribution, Installation, Updates & Version Compatibility
objective: Turn SMB-13 internal-alpha productization into beta-grade distribution: supported installers/packages, version verification, update flow, safe upgrade path, client/server compatibility, stale-client behavior, migration between beta builds and recovery from interrupted/failed updates.
acceptance: Ordinary supported users can install, update, recover from an interrupted update and resume the same authoritative Campaign state without developer hand-holding.
boundaries: BRP-01..03 and SMB-01..16 remain sealed predecessor authority.
BRP-04 is selected_not_started only and has no implementation authority until governed start.
Beta distribution proof may harden installation/update/recovery/version compatibility but may not authorize public beta, stores, commerce, paid infrastructure or release.
Authoritative Campaign identity/history and migration ownership remain with their sealed owner systems.
BRP must complete through BRP-11 BETA_READY before normal SMB-17 activation.
next_action: Establish causal RED for supported package/install verification, update and safe-upgrade flow, client/server compatibility and stale-client behavior, beta-build migration, interrupted/failed update recovery, and authoritative Campaign resume without developer hand-holding; then implement BRP-04 only.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue authorizes BRP-04 governed start after BRP-03 completed_verified.
